test_cases.test_scenario: Calculate bill using valid previous and current meter readings
test_steps: Open the bill calculation screen or service.
test_cases.expected_result: The system calculates usage as 150 units and the bill amount as 37.50 using (1350 - 1200) x 0.25. The bill is accepted and returned successfully.

test_cases.test_scenario: Calculate bill using zero consumption when previous and current readings are equal
test_steps: Open the bill calculation screen or service.
test_cases.expected_result: The system calculates usage as 0 units and the bill amount as 0.00 using (1500 - 1500) x 0.30. The bill is accepted and returned successfully.

test_cases.test_scenario: Reject a negative previous meter reading
test_steps: Open the bill calculation screen or service.
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the request because the previous meter reading is negative. No bill is calculated and an error message is displayed.

test_cases.test_scenario: Reject a negative current meter reading
test_steps: Open the bill calculation screen or service.
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the request because the current meter reading is negative. No bill is calculated and an error message is displayed.

test_cases.test_scenario: Reject when current meter reading is lower than previous meter reading
test_steps: Open the bill calculation screen or service.
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the request because the current meter reading is lower than the previous meter reading. No bill is calculated and an error message is displayed.

test_cases.test_scenario: Accept minimum valid meter readings at zero and calculate zero bill
test_steps: Open the bill calculation screen or service.
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts both readings because they are not negative and the current reading is not lower than the previous reading. Usage is 0 units and the bill amount is 0.00.

test_cases.test_scenario: Calculate bill with decimal unit rate and valid readings
test_steps: Open the bill calculation screen or service.
test_cases.expected_result: The system calculates usage as 250 units and the bill amount as 46.8750 using (2750 - 2500) x 0.1875. The bill is accepted and returned successfully.

unclear_requirements: The business rules do not specify whether non-integer meter readings are allowed.
The business rules do not specify the required validation behavior for blank or null meter readings.
The business rules do not specify whether the unit rate can be zero or negative.
The business rules do not specify rounding rules for bill amounts beyond exact decimal calculation.
The business rules do not specify the exact error message text for validation failures.
